_fill_instructions: Fill every contract field from the parsed PDF. Evidence items carry 'field': table values -> {field, type:'table_cell', table, page, row{KEY:VALUE}, column:'A/B', value}; text -> {field, page, block_id|table_id, quote}; page images -> {field, type:'image_region', page, bbox, crop, transcription}. field_status per field: text_layer | image_read | unreadable. Use null + an 'unreported' entry when the PDF does not report it or it cannot be read.
